encoding: RFC8785 canonical JSON; SHA256 digests and P256 SHA256withECDSA DER signatures use unpadded base64url. Public keys are X509 SPKI DER base64url.

offer.name: Cere
offer.replacesDeviceId: optional UUID of the existing phone being replaced on the same desktop

pairing.response: responseBody plus connectionProof and actionProof signatures of responseSignatureTranscript using respective keys
pairing.sas: SHA256 UTF8(offerDigest + '.' + digest(complete signed response)); first six bytes index sas-words.json; join words with spaces
pairing.replacement: A signed replacesDeviceId must match the saved desktop/device. Replacement reuses project IDs, revokes old authority, preserves local drafts/cache, and requires reconciliation of pending commands first. Policy is chosen locally in the signed offer, not supplied by the phone.

approval.title: Question
approval.agentId: optional opaque reference of the session agent that raised this request (feature agent.refs)

events: snapshot.changed (reconcile scoped snapshot, including resolved approvals)
attachment.progress (data is upload DTO; cursor is opaque like other events)

notice (data {kind:'complete'|'error'|'interrupted', sessionId, title} for in-scope sessions, or {kind:'timer', projectId, timerId, label} for timers set from this device's projects; text is generic and never carries provider error detail)

notes: All operations are capability negotiated. Absent operation must have no enabled control. Unsupported forms/unsafe active providers expose deny/Stop only. All mutation failures preserve drafts. Connection loss never queues a new action. On ambiguous mutation query commands.status with original ID. All snapshot arrays replace cached scope; removed resources must be purged. Reconnect always supports full scoped snapshot even without retained replay. No command retry with a new ID without review. TLS trust exactly paired SPKI and valid certificate/SAN. No network pairing endpoint. Session summaries set draftIncluded:false; fetch sessions.get before enabling Send. A positive draftAttachmentCount means the desktop draft must be reviewed there; mobile draft edits and sends do not discard those attachments. sync.open sessionIds is authoritative for cache removal; hydrate omitted summaries by ID with sessions.batch (feature sessions.batch), or with sessions.list and nextSessionOffset on an older desktop. Submitted Ollama image files can be removed after a completed turn because full image context is persisted. Native path inputs remain until session removal, local clear, or device revocation. Command outcomes are redacted across device scopeVersion changes. Memory invalidation clears retained result payloads. cacheEpoch changes clear phone transcript and transient memory views. Memory CAS revisions above 9007199254740991 are rejected.

media.binaryFrame: 16-byte UUID, 8-byte unsigned big endian offset, up to 262144 payload bytes; single outstanding chunk per upload; wait attachment.progress before next chunk
media.upload: attachments.begin signed; binary chunks; attachments.status after reconnect; attachments.commit signed; session-specific opaque IDs in signed sessions.send
media.preview: approvals.preview returns readId,size,mime,sha256,imageDigest,expiresAt. attachments.read sends binary read frame then response {bytes:payloadLength}. Verify full preview sha256, show preview, add imageDigest to signed approvals.answer for image Allow. Handles expire or become invalid when approval resolves.

attachments.commit.result: same DTO with status ready and width/height

compatibility.versioning: Major changes are incompatible and close the hello with 4010 INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT_NEWER or INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT_OLDER, naming the side to update. Minor versions only add: an operation is used only when negotiated in operations, other new behaviour only when named in features.
compatibility.forwardCompatibleFields: Clients ignore unknown fields in responses and events, unknown event names, and unknown status/kind strings. Revisions are decimal strings of any length.
compatibility.strictInput: The desktop rejects unknown request fields, methods and enum values; a client sends a new parameter only when its feature is negotiated.
compatibility.failClosedEnums: actionAuthentication is security-relevant: an unknown value fails the welcome instead of being guessed.
compatibility.signing: Canonical JSON (RFC 8785), digests and signature transcripts are unchanged by minor versions.
compatibility.fixtures: conformance.json holds normalized frames recorded from a real gateway (tests/mobile-conformance.test.ts) and hand-written forward-compatible frames; Android ConformanceTest decodes all of them.

features.activity.page: activity.page pages Activity with a continuation cursor
features.sessions.batch: sessions.batch hydrates named sessions; missing ones are reported
features.message.sources: messages carry bounded source titles and URLs
features.citations.display: settings.showMemoryCitations says whether memory citations are shown and copied
features.agent.refs: agents and approvals name agents by opaque references, never native thread IDs
features.captures: captures.* and capture.updated: phone-started screen captures
features.drafts.desktopAttachments: session draftAttachments, drafts.attachmentPreview, drafts.put desktopAttachmentIds and sessions.send desktopAttachments
features.messages.bookmarks: pinned replies: message bookmarked, messages.bookmark, messages.bookmarks
features.sessions.behavior: sessions.behavior names a conversation's effective style and where it is set
features.desktop.portrait: desktop.portrait serves the still status portrait
features.desktop.workspace: desktop.workspace serves the scoped workspace card
features.sessions.focusTerminal: sessions.focusTerminal brings a linked conversation's terminal forward on the desktop
